scenario: [LIMP.13.2]: a `lib.Schema` head behaves as a bare one. [LCCO.7.2]: a `timeout` clause's timer carries the parent bindings its body reads. Rule `r` matches `jobs.Job j` and calls `svc.get` with `timeout 5_s:` logging `late {j.id}`. A Job with id 7 is asserted and pumped, nothing answers, the clock moves 5 s and the pump fires the timeout. Exactly ["late 7"]. The break is a timer schema with no `j_id` slot, because the binding's head was read only when bare. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.body_binding_head`, through `head_schema_name`, feeding `rule_timeout_timers` and `head_timer_slots`.
rules_ds:
import jobs

schema Reply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service svc.get:
    kwarg n: Int
    response Reply

rule r:
    jobs.Job j
->
    call svc.get n: j.id nocooldown
        timeout 5_s:
            log info "late {j.id}"

libraries.jobs:
schema Job scope explicit:
    id: Int
